trigger: They want me to sign a statement
description: What to do if the police are pressuring you to write or sign a statement.

steps.text: You have the right to remain silent until you speak to your lawyer (s.35(2)).
Say: 'I would like my lawyer present before I make or sign any statement.'
Do not sign a statement you did not write, or one you have not read fully.
Do not sign a blank or incomplete page. Never sign under threat or beating.
You are presumed innocent (s.36(5)); you do not have to prove anything to them now.
If you are forced to write, you may state that you are doing so under duress and without a lawyer.
Call your lawyer before signing anything.
